purpose: AdSense/search quality review before re-indexing private certificate detail pages

policy.A: Current page has enough certificate-specific, independently useful content to be considered for immediate indexing.
policy.B: Page has a concrete subject or job/skill domain, but shared-template content is still too prominent. Add certificate-specific content before indexing.
policy.C: High duplication/ambiguity risk or weak independent qualification value. Keep noindex until a deeper rewrite with verifiable certificate-specific information is completed.

p1PostEnhancementReview.result: No P1 page promoted to A in this pass; keep all 15 noindex.
renderingEvidence: loadCertificate merges data/quality/private-p1-enrichments.json for private certificate slugs.
buildVisibility exposes search-intent when custom query/answer items exist.
CertificateRenderer renders SearchIntent for the visible search-intent section.
SearchIntent renders the custom title, summary, related questions/answers, related keywords and notes.
p1PostEnhancementReview.indexingEvidence: APPROVED_PRIVATE_SLUGS remains empty, so all reviewed private pages remain noindex.
reviewCriteria: certificate-specific search intent and practical usefulness
duplication risk across shared template sections
verifiable official or primary-source support where claims can change or affect legal/safety decisions
independent value beyond generic registered-private-certificate guidance

barista.reason: Search-intent content is clearly barista-specific, but eligibility, official-info, cost and much of the reality guidance remain shared-template dominant.

personal-color-consultant.reason: Diagnosis, lighting and portfolio guidance add clear uniqueness, but the page still needs more certificate-specific curriculum, assessment and operator/source detail.

pet-behavior-specialist.reason: Behavior observation, referral boundaries and safety guidance are useful, but stronger primary-source grounding and more role-specific curriculum/assessment detail are needed.

pet-funeral-director.reason: Legal distinction from animal funeral business licensing materially improves the page, but the qualification-specific operator/registration and training structure are still not sufficiently deep for A.

pet-grooming-specialist.reason: Hands-on grooming and safety guidance is distinct, while the remaining acquisition/cost/official sections still contain substantial shared-template language.

fitness-trainer.reason: Programming, anatomy and referral-boundary guidance is useful, but qualification-specific assessment, education hours and stronger authoritative sourcing are still needed.

pilates-instructor.reason: Equipment, cueing and teaching-practice content is distinct, but the page remains too generic about the actual private qualification structure and issuing bodies.

yoga-instructor.reason: Sequencing, teaching and safety content is distinct, but qualification-specific curriculum/assessment and source depth remain insufficient.

video-editing-specialist.reason: Portfolio, codec, audio and rights-aware workflow content improves independent value, but the qualification itself is still described largely through generic private-certificate structure.

web-design-specialist.reason: Responsive design, HTML/CSS and accessibility content is useful, but the page needs more qualification-specific curriculum/assessment evidence and source-backed standards.

coding-instructor.reason: Teaching-plan and classroom-skill guidance is distinct, but actual qualification curriculum, assessment and issuing-body evidence are not yet deep enough.

chatgpt-specialist.reason: Verification, privacy and workplace-use guidance is highly relevant, but product-policy claims require maintained primary-source support and the qualification-specific structure is still thin.

generative-ai-specialist.reason: Workflow, human verification and portfolio guidance add value, but qualification-specific training/assessment and primary-source grounding remain insufficient.

smart-store-specialist.reason: Margin, returns, settlement and operations guidance is commercially useful, but the qualification-specific portion remains generic and platform information needs maintained primary-source support.

ecommerce-manager.reason: Metrics, multi-channel operations and project-based practice are distinct, but qualification-specific curriculum/assessment and authoritative source support remain too shallow for A.

p1PostEnhancementReview.nextAction: Deepen P1 pages one by one with verified qualification/operator/registration details where identifiable, certificate-specific curriculum/assessment structure, and primary-source-backed legal/platform/safety facts; then re-review individually and add only A slugs to APPROVED_PRIVATE_SLUGS.

notes: This audit covers the fixed 100-item private-certificate master list, not every repository entry whose basic.type is private.
A is intentionally empty at this stage because the current 100 pages were produced from a highly shared template and should not be re-indexed before certificate-specific enhancement.
B pages are not low-value by definition; they are the first recovery pool because their subject/job domains allow genuinely distinct content to be added.

C pages should not be padded with generic prose. Reconsider indexability only after verifying the qualification's operator, registration/public status where applicable, real curriculum/assessment structure, and limits on professional practice claims.

Nationally accredited or international private credentials outside this fixed 100-item master list (for example ITQ or MOS) require a separate review and should not inherit this 100-item grade automatically.

P1 search-intent enrichment passed the code-path rendering check, but none of the 15 pages met A because most non-search-intent sections still contain substantial shared-template content and qualification-specific primary-source evidence remains limited.
